newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin health satisfactory after surgery - doctor.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin health satisfactory after surgery - doctor.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin is in satisfactory condition after his operation and will probably spend up to two more weeks in hospital followed by a month in a sanatorium, the Kremlin's chief doctor said on Monday.
Sergei Mironov told a news conference that Yeltsin's appetite was returning after Tuesday's quintuple heart bypass operation and his temperature had been normal for four days.
"The condition of Boris Nikolayevich is satisfactory," Mironov said. "He is already asking quite a lot of questions about the details of the operation and its technical aspects."
Mironov said Yeltsin, 65, would probably spend another 1-1/2 or two weeks in the Central Clinical Hospital, followed by about a month in the Barvikha sanatorium outside the Russian capital.
Yeltsin has spent only a handful of days in the Kremlin since he was re-elected for a second term in office on July 3.
The Kremlin said Yeltsin would address the nation this week, but a spokesman did not make clear what the address would be about or if it would be on radio or television.
